verses.text: <pb/><t>Jehova, cheta ihe ruworo ayi aru:</t> <t>Legide anya, hu ita-uta-ayi.</t>
<t>Ihe-nketa-ayi ab͕anwewo ihe ndi ala ọzọ,</t> <t>Ulo nile ab͕anwewo ihe ndi mba ọzọ.</t>
<t>Umu-nb͕ei ka ayi ghọworo, bú ndi nēnweghi nna,</t> <t>Nne-ayi-hà di ka ndinyom di-ha nwuru.</t>
<t>Miri-ayi ka ayi jiworo ego ṅua;</t> <t>Nkú-ayi nābiara ayi n'ọnu-ahia.</t>
<t>Ọ bu inọkwasi n'olu-ayi ka achuworo ayi:</t> <t>Ayi adọb͕uwo onwe-ayi n'ọlu, ma ekweghi ka ayi zuru ike.</t>
<t>Ijipt ka ayi kweyeworo ekweye,</t> <t>Ya na Asiria, ka nri we ju ayi afọ.</t>
<t>Nna-ayi-hà emehiewo, ha adighi kwa ndu;</t> <t>Ayi onwe-ayi eburuwo ajọ omume nile ha.</t>
<t>Ndi-orù achiwo ayi:</t> <t>Ọ dighi onye nānaputa ayi n'aka-ha.</t>
<t>Ayi ji ndu-ayi n'aka weta nri-ayi</t> <t>N'ihi mma-agha nke ọzara.</t>
<t>Akpukpọ-aru-ayi di ọku dika ite-ọku uku</t> <t>Site n'ifufe di ọku nke oké ugwu.</t>
<t>Ndinyom nke di na Zaion ka ha wedara n'ala,</t> <t>Ha na umu-ab͕ọghọ nāmaghi nwoke n'obodo nile nke Juda.</t>
<t>Ekobere ndi-isi n'aka-ha:</t> <t>Asọpughi iru ndi-okenye.</t>
<t>Umu-okorọbia buru nkume-igwe-nri,</t> <t>Umu-okoro su-kwa-ra ngọngọ n'okpuru nkú.</t>
<t>Ndi-okenye akwusiwo inọ n'ọnu-uzọ-ama,</t> <t>Umu-okorọbia akwusiwo ikpọ ubọ-akwara-ha.</t>
<t>Obi-utọ nke obi-ayi akwusiwo;</t> <t>Otite-egwú-ayi ab͕anwewo n'ib͕a-nkpe.</t>
<t>Okpu-eze nke isi-ayi adawo n'ala:</t> <t>Ahuhu nādiri ayi nọ̄! n'ihi na ayi emehiewo.</t>
<t>N'ihi nka ka aru nādighi obi-ayi nma;</t> <t>N'ihi ihe ndia ka anya-ayi b͕aworo ọchichiri.</t>
<t>N'ihi ugwu Zaion, nke tọb͕ọrọ n'efu;</t> <t>Nkita-ọhia ejeghariwo na ya.</t>
<t>Gi onwe-gi, Jehova, ọ bu rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi ka I nānọdu dika eze;</t> <t>Oche-eze-Gi nādiru ọb͕ọ nile.</t>
<t>N'ìhi gini ka I nēchezọ ayi rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi?</t> <t>N'ìhi gini ka I nārapu ayi rue ogologo ubọchi nile?</t>
<t>Me ka ayi laghachikute Gi, Jehova, ayi gālata kwa;</t> <t>Me ka ubọchi nile ayi di ọhu dika na mb͕e ochie.</t>
<t>Ma-ọbughi na I jusiwo ayi,</t> <t>Wesa ayi iwe nke-uku.</t>
